tool_description: Aider AI Code Assistant for proposing and executing code fixes and feature implementations

available_commands.description: Propose an Aider command to fix a specific issue in a file
Propose an Aider command to implement a new feature across files
Propose fixes for issues found by scan_code
Run the pending Aider command after user confirmation
Cancel the pending Aider command without running
Check if there is a pending Aider command waiting for confirmation

tool_usage_guidance: Always PROPOSE first with propose_fix or propose_feature
Never auto-run without explicit user approval
Wait for user to say 'confirm' or 'yes' before calling confirm_and_run
Use propose_fix_from_scan to auto-propose fixes for issues Anna found
IMPORTANT: Aider requires 'aider-chat' package installed: pip install aider-chat
proactive_triggers: When user asks 'fix this code' or 'implement this feature'
After code scanning detects issues that can be automatically fixed
When user explicitly requests Aider assistance with code
When proposing major refactoring or new implementations

metadata.notes: Requires Aider CLI installed. Always proposes commands and waits for user confirmation before executing.
